g.text: Formula is a small car running on battery that can be controlled on a smartphone or pc via a website.
The Arduino on the car receives instructions how to drive.
The two back wheels provide movement, while the front wheels turn left and right. All the car parts is connected
The website has large buttons for:
When a button is pressed, the instruction is sent to the car over wifi.
Light to indicate, for example, if its connected to the internet.
